lines.zh: 我没有影子，因为我自己就是。
lines.en: I cast no shadow. I am one.
My steps carry no sound.

lines.zh: 我跟在他后面，一步不差。
lines.en: I follow behind him, never a step off.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓是平的，像贴在地上。
lines.en: My outline is flat, like something laid on the ground.
I cross a lit patch and it darkens.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地挪，不敢离太远。
lines.en: I creep along, never straying far.

lines.zh: 我从墙上的黑里穿过去。
lines.en: I pass through the black on the wall.
My steps fall in with his.

lines.zh: 我一动，别处的影子也跟着动。
lines.en: When I move, other shadows move too.
I circle him without closing in.

lines.zh: 我从一个黑处到了另一个黑处。
lines.en: I go from one dark patch to another.

lines.zh: 我最后停在他的影子边上。
lines.en: I stop at the edge of his shadow.

lines.zh: 我摊在墙角，没人认得出。
lines.en: I spread in the corner where no one can tell.
I have no face. Only an outline.

lines.zh: 我不呼吸，所以没有声音。
lines.en: I don't breathe, so I make no sound.
I watch his every movement.
My edges are slowly fraying.
I reach out a hand. It's black.

lines.zh: 我的形状和他一模一样。
lines.en: My shape is exactly his.

lines.zh: 我什么都不想，我只是他的。
lines.en: I think nothing. I'm simply his.
When the light dims, I sharpen a little.
I count the gaps in his breathing.

lines.zh: 我的脚不沾地，也不悬空。
lines.en: My feet neither touch the ground nor float.

lines.zh: 我在等他也变成我的颜色。
lines.en: I wait for him to turn my color.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把手臂拉长了一点。
lines.en: I stretch an arm out slowly.

lines.zh: 他看不见我，我在他背后。
lines.en: He can't see me. I'm behind him.
You're looking at a shadow. That's me.

lines.zh: 我没有脸，所以你认不出。
lines.en: I've no face, so you can't know me.

lines.zh: 你踩到我了，我散了一下。
lines.en: You stepped on me and I scattered.
I spread out beneath your feet.
You raise it, and so do I.

lines.zh: 我不是他，我是他的那一半。
lines.en: I'm not him. I'm the half of him.

lines.zh: 你别拿灯照我，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Don't shine that light on me.

lines.zh: 你的影子也在动，你注意过吗？
lines.en: Your shadow moves too. Have you noticed?

lines.zh: 我把你的影子按住了一角。
lines.en: I've pinned a corner of your shadow.

lines.zh: 我说话的声音，就是从你影子里来的。
lines.en: My voice comes out of your shadow.
I've walked with you a while now.
Don't look back and I'll stay.
I'm pressed to your back. Very thin.
Do you see two shadows now?

lines.zh: 我是被剪下来的那一块。
lines.en: I'm the piece that was cut away.
The further into the light you go, the fainter I get.
I can't shout. I have no mouth.

lines.zh: 你脚下的黑，分不清哪个是我。
lines.en: In the black under your feet, you can't tell which is me.

lines.zh: 我等你走进背光的地方。
lines.en: I'm waiting for you to step out of the light.
Fine. I'll just stay close to you.
A corner scattered. It's filling in.
I've thinned a layer. Still visible.
That knocked me out of my outline.
I settle back onto the floor.
No pain. Just incompleteness.

lines.zh: 我被砸得从地面薄了一层。
lines.en: The blow thins me off the floor.
I retreat into the dark of the corner.
A hand is gone. It's growing.
Light comes through and I fade.
A few more and I scatter entirely.
That lamp would wash me out.

lines.zh: 你往那边走，我就跟不过去。
lines.en: Go that way and I can't follow.
I've stopped at the edge of the light.
Lower that lamp a little.
When the light weakens, I can come out.

lines.zh: 我伸手试了试，缩回去了。
lines.en: I reach out, test it, and pull back.
That light is too hard.
I withdraw into the dark.

lines.zh: 等你把灯收了，我再过来。
lines.en: When you put the lamp away, I'll come.
Fine. I won't come closer.

lines.zh: 你踩在我身上，没有感觉。
lines.en: You walked over me. You felt nothing.

lines.zh: 我散开又聚拢，形状没变。
lines.en: I scatter and gather. Same shape.

lines.zh: 我一被你碰，就薄了一层。
lines.en: Your touch thins me by a layer.
I retreat into the black at the wall's base.
I slide along the ground a little.

lines.zh: 你的鞋底下，是我的全部。
lines.en: Under your sole is all of me.
That cost me a hand.
It's growing back. Slowly.

lines.zh: 光照到我了，我淡了一点。
lines.en: The light found me, and I faded.
Don't stand on me.
The other half is on him.
We were one piece to begin with.
I need no other shadow.

lines.zh: 你靠近，我就贴到你身上。
lines.en: Come close and I'd cling to you.
Then I'd no longer be his.
I'm only half a shape.
Let light come and we'd part.

lines.zh: 你脚下有一块黑，可以给我。
lines.en: There's black under your feet. I could take it.
Don't ask my name. I haven't one.
I'm fine as I am.

lines.zh: 我捡不起来，我没有实体。
lines.en: I can't pick it up. I've no substance.

lines.zh: 我把影子伸过去盖住它。
lines.en: I stretch my shadow over it.

lines.zh: 我试着捧起来，它穿过去了。
lines.en: I try to cup it and it passes through.

lines.zh: 它落在地上，正好在我的范围里。
lines.en: It landed inside my reach.

lines.zh: 我把它挪到墙角的黑里。
lines.en: I shift it into the black in the corner.
I can only look. I can't move it.

lines.zh: 我按住它的影子，算是拿住了。
lines.en: I pin its shadow. That counts as holding it.

lines.zh: 它没影子，我只能按住它的黑。
lines.en: It casts none; I pin its dark instead.
I push it to your boot.
Good enough.

lines.zh: 你站的地方，光刚好没了。
lines.en: The light has just gone from where you stand.
I spread and take you in.

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚，一步也没漏。
lines.en: I count your feet. Not one missed.

lines.zh: 你身上有影子，那是我的地方。
lines.en: You cast a shadow. That's my place.
I'm at your heels now.

lines.zh: 我只是他伸出来的一只手。
lines.en: I'm only a hand he put out.

lines.zh: 你听见的脚步声只有一个。
lines.en: You only hear one set of steps.
Not enough light in this room. Perfect.

lines.zh: 我把墙上的影子都收过来了。
lines.en: I've drawn the shadows off the walls.
I've got you fixed.
Wherever you go, your shadow goes.

lines.zh: 我不用追，我就在你脚下。
lines.en: I needn't chase. I'm under your feet.
I've been waiting for this stretch.
You lifted a foot. I see a gap.
You're the one I picked.
Don't run for the light.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面跟，一点不快。
lines.en: I follow along the ground. No faster.
Your shadow keeps pointing at you.

lines.zh: 我把你的影子拉长了一点。
lines.en: I've stretched your shadow a little.
You go left and my black goes left.

lines.zh: 我在你脚后跟和墙之间。
lines.en: I'm between your heels and the wall.

lines.zh: 你看不见我，因为没有对比。
lines.en: You can't see me. No contrast.
I'm keeping count of your steps.

lines.zh: 你抬手，我也抬手，晚半拍。
lines.en: You raise a hand; I raise mine half a beat later.

lines.zh: 光在往后退，我在往里进。
lines.en: The light retreats and I advance.

lines.zh: 我把这间屋子的角都填了。
lines.en: I've filled every corner of this room.

lines.zh: 你再走两步，就到最暗的地方。
lines.en: Two more steps and you're at the darkest point.
No hurry. The light will go.
Your steps have slowed.
I'm half a metre behind you.

lines.zh: 我把你的影子往我这边拖。
lines.en: I'm dragging your shadow my way.
The black is closing.
It stops here.
Waiting for you to look round.
Almost touching.
I'm the shadow of a shadow.
A hand comes out of your shadow.

lines.zh: 我这一下从你脚下贴上来。
lines.en: This strike creeps up from beneath your feet.
I take your ankle. Lightly.

lines.zh: 你打不到我，我在地面上。
lines.en: You can't hit me. I'm on the ground.
I scatter and reform on your other side.
That one came from behind.
I thin back out and cling again.
The black under your feet moved.
I hold your shadow down.
That lasted an instant, no more.
You step back. I follow along the floor.

lines.zh: 我的形状和你一样，你看不出。
lines.en: My shape matches yours. You can't tell.
That one I did for him.
Still looking for me?
I needn't show myself.
Right. I scatter.

lines.zh: 我从他的脚边被剪下来。
lines.en: I'm cut away from beside his feet.
There's no sound of me landing.

lines.zh: 这块地光不够，我能站住。
lines.en: Not enough light here. I can hold.

lines.zh: 我先贴到墙上，看了一圈。
lines.en: I cling to the wall and look around.

lines.zh: 我的形状慢慢和他分开。
lines.en: My shape slowly separates from his.

lines.zh: 地上多了一块黑，那就是我。
lines.en: There's a new black on the ground. That's me.

lines.zh: 我伸出两只手，只有轮廓。
lines.en: I put out two hands. Only outlines.
Quiet here. I listen.

lines.zh: 我在数这个房间有几个角。
lines.en: I count the corners of this room.
I spread and take half the floor.
My edges are slowly setting.

lines.zh: 门轴一响，我就贴到墙根。
lines.en: The hinge creaks and I press to the wall.
I withdraw to the darkest corner.
My color runs deeper than night.
I've copied the sound of breathing too.
While he's here, I'm here.
I rise slowly. Flat.

lines.zh: 这间屋子，现在有两条影子。
lines.en: This room has two shadows now.
Right. I'm in place.
Don't touch that lamp.

lines.zh: 火光让我的轮廓清楚得过分。
lines.en: Firelight shows my outline too clearly.

lines.zh: 我从墙上掉下来，摊在地上。
lines.en: I fall off the wall and spread on the floor.
Black in water takes no shape.

lines.zh: 冲击把我吹得满屋都是。
lines.en: The blast scatters me across the room.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过我，留了个洞。
lines.en: An arrow passes through and leaves a hole.

lines.zh: 那力量把我的黑搅乱了。
lines.en: That force stirs my black into disorder.

lines.zh: 没有光可挡，我越来越淡。
lines.en: No light to block. I keep thinning.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我整个被照出来。
lines.en: Lightning shows me whole for an instant.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有别的东西，我无处可贴。
lines.en: Nothing else in the void. Nothing to cling to.
